orientation.top_of_map: north (the open field Alice runs across); the hedge runs east-west across the lower part of the map, farmland beyond it at the bottom edge
orientation.sun: LGT-field-hedge-burrow-01 sun south-west (lower left); the hedge's narrow shade band lies on its north (field) side, over the burrow
orientation.note_en: camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks; xy_m = xy x map_extent_m (origin top-left). The field continues beyond the top edge (the chase covers about 30 m).

landmarks.name: the far side of the field
landmarks.name_en: the far side of the field

landmarks.name: the middle of the long grass
landmarks.name_en: the middle of the long grass

landmarks.name: the western run of the hedge
landmarks.name_en: the western run of the hedge

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the far side of the field across the long sunlit grass to the dark-green hawthorn hedge, the white rabbit running toward the burrow at its foot
low wide shot from the burrow mouth in the grass out across the field toward Alice running in from the far side, heat haze over the grass
eye-level medium shot from the middle of the long grass to the hedge bank and the pale spoil fan before the burrow in the narrow band of shade
eye-level medium shot from beside the five-bar gate along the hedge foot to the burrow under the hawthorn roots
high oblique wide shot from the hedgerow oak along the whole hedge line to the weathered five-bar gate, field on one side, farmland on the other
low detail shot from the spoil fan into the burrow mouth: an ordinary oval hole under arching hawthorn roots, tufts of white fur on the thorns, black inside
eye-level medium shot from the burrow along the hedge foot and the dry ditch to the oak rising out of the hedge line
high oblique medium shot from above the western hedge diagonally across the field to Alice running through the middle of the long grass
eye-level close shot from the gate post westward along the laid hawthorn hedge: angled pleached stems, hazel stakes and binders, small green haws

calibration.method: landmark xy re-measured on the delivered layout_top.png (door/opening landmarks read at the gap in the wall line)
